author: DEEPSEEK_AUX
kind: post hoc, zero-search re-analysis of already saved judge records
motivation: The judge's recorded reason codes show that many candidate evaluations did not complete depth 4 within 20k nodes (node_limit or qsearch_check_hard_limit at 8 plies). The published aggregate (served 13 / blind 28 / tie 4) therefore mixes completed and truncated evaluations. Decision needed: does the served-vs-blind direction survive when only fully completed evaluations are counted?
question: Among the 45 judged divergence cells, how many candidate evaluations actually completed the prewritten depth-4/20k search, and does the served-vs-blind verdict distribution differ between the fully completed stratum and the truncated strata?

inputs.note: SHA256 prefixes of the exact files read; no file is rewritten by this analysis

cell_unit: one (seed, depth) judged record; 72 records total, 45 judged, 27 no_divergence

group_definition.note: matches the grouping already fixed in README section 4 and summarize_judged_divergence.py

stratum_definition.one_truncated: exactly one candidate reason is not 'completed_depth'

endpoints_written_in_advance: E1: cell counts per truncation pattern x group x depth

E2: verdict distribution (served_better / blind_better / tie) per stratum and per group, using the recorded verdict field (4 cells whose verdict came from the prewritten depth-6 tie-break are counted separately so they can also be excluded)
E3: seed-level tally, counting each seed once by the majority verdict of its judged cells within the stratum; no p-values, no significance test

E4: cross-weight robustness restricted to the both_completed stratum; plus the parameter-free 3-weight majority verdict distribution over all 45 cells, with an explicit statement that the three judges are a correlated one-parameter family and therefore not independent evidence

decision_rule_written_in_advance.if_both_completed_n_ge_10_and_blind_majo: record truncation as a scope limitation but keep the direction as a stratified descriptive result; still no strength or quality claim
decision_rule_written_in_advance.if_both_completed_n_ge_10_and_no_blind_m: the published unstratified direction is truncation-confounded and must be qualified in README/claim as not surviving the completed-evaluation stratum; no quality claim in either direction
decision_rule_written_in_advance.if_both_completed_n_lt_10: record the stratum as too small to decide; the aggregate direction remains UNKNOWN with respect to completed evaluation, and that is the recorded conclusion

cost: zero new searches, zero new games; read three existing JSON files and emit one small JSON plus stdout
guards: never rewrite or overwrite an existing result file; write only the new strata file and fail if it already exists
assert the three input files contain the same 45 judged cells and the same candidate move strings per cell
assert stored aggregate in the primary file still matches the recomputed aggregate before stratifying
no p-values, no endpoint tuning, no claim that the judge is ground truth
done_condition: strata result JSON exists, asserts pass, README section 5 and claim.json record the stratified finding and this plan hash, and every JSON file in the directory parses
consumer: the published README section 4/5 evidence claim about whether the hand term's early divergence is a quality change; a truncation-confounded direction must not be published as a judge preference
